content:
**Nocturnal Fortitude** is an Endurance-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Increased Max HP between 6:00 p.m. and 6:00 a.m.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★ | 2 | Gain +40 to Max Health between the hours of 6:00 p.m. and 6:00 a.m. | 00259DB6 | 
| ★ | 1 | Gain +20 to Max Health between the hours of 6:00 p.m. and 6:00 a.m. | 00259C55 |
